M-MODULE.NAME: Index navigation commands
M-MODULE.purpose: Expose index-first navigation commands (module/phase/verification) with validated ids and readable XML errors.

export-moduleShowCmd.PURPOSE: Show one module file; unique id prefixes are resolved.

CrossLink.relation: validates every id before it reaches the filesystem
structural reads; malformed XML becomes XML_INVALID

contract.purpose: Expose index-first navigation commands (module/phase/verification) with validated ids and readable XML errors.

param.name: id
param.description: Module, phase or verification id or unique module prefix.

param.name: stdout
param.description: Index text, entity text or filtered tables.

error.description: Index contains an id outside the grammar.

notes.note-1: Index-first is enforced by design: commands read docs/*.xml indexes, not arbitrary files.
notes.note-2: Raw index text is validated before printing so a corrupt index never looks like an empty one.
notes.note-3: Ids printed from an index are re-validated defensively before they reach other tools.
notes.note-4: Sharding: list/find/index and unique-prefix resolution read the transparent union of root and shard entries; module show still reads docs/modules/M-XXX.xml directly.
